disorder-name.detail: Autism Spectrum Disorder; 571 cases diagnosed according to DSM-IV-TR at each contributing ABIDE site. Normative model was built from typically developing controls (N=1146), then applied to ASD cases to estimate volumetric deviations.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "The current study includes the data of 571 cases with ASD who had both symptom assessments and T1 images, and 1146 controls with T1 images. The cases were diagnosed according to DSM-IV-TR at each contributing site."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Data from both ABIDE-I and ABIDE-II were used. 1094 participants from ABIDE-I and 1100 from ABIDE-II passed preprocessing. Both TDC (normative model) and ASD cases were drawn from ABIDE.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The study analyzed both structural neuroimaging data and phenotypic data provided by the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE)...We had 1094 participants in ABIDE I and 1100 participants in ABIDE II who passed the preprocessing"
dataset-of-origin.location: Zhang2023.pdf.md: Methods / Participants (Section 2.1) and Neuroimaging preprocessing (Section 2.2)
